get.description:
Returns transactions for the given DID, filtered by token type (rbt, nft, ft, smartContract).
Optional query parameters narrow results further:
- latest: return only the N most recent transactions sorted by epoch descending (e.g. latest=5)
- start_date / end_date: filter by created_at date range, inclusive, format YYYY-MM-DD
- start_epoch / end_epoch: filter by epoch range, inclusive integer values

parentNFTId.description:
ParentNFTId, when non-empty, signals a child-mint instruction: this entry
mints a brand-new child NFT linked to the named parent. The parent is
executed in the same transaction. NFTId is ignored when ParentNFTId is set —
the server derives the child NFT ID via IPFS-add of parentNFTId+uuid.
